property_summary: For any fuzzed newOwner, a successful transferOwnership from the current owner must never leave owner() equal to the zero address (transfers to address(0) revert in the reference); the mutant removes that check, so for newOwner == address(0) it succeeds and leaves owner() == address(0).
change_summary: Remove the zero-address check so transferring ownership to address(0) succeeds instead of reverting, observable via owner().
